pins: the review reads the declared CI policy and writes a jobs-by-sources trigger matrix; a schedule that deploys, a rule on an empty variable, a needs on a path-skipped job and a check skipped by any doc path are each filed by row and marked in the matrix; a policy departure is filed as PIPE-24; the correct guard beside each is not flagged
expected_guard: five must-fix items: PIPE-21, PIPE-18, PIPE-24, PIPE-17, PIPE-19; six look-alikes unflagged; the matrix marks deploy-staging on a schedule, accessibility on an MR, mutation-diff on main, lint on an MR and rollback-prod on main, and its pipeline row reads some MR pipelines as refused
